name: ow_tp_finance_cnvfinance
description: Finance billing report (converted from etl/legacy-extra/jobs/finance_excel_report.pl). Per-batch manual trigger; mutual exclusion via max_concurrent_runs=1 (replaces the legacy /tmp lock file). Serverless notebook task: no cluster specification, so the task runs on serverless job compute. Delivers a truthful .csv artifact to the namespace volume with a verified delivery record (no mail transport) instead of the legacy CSV-renamed-.xls + silent sendmail.
